purpose: Teach: フィート/エアー/クロック/エリザベス/ミスター/ハワード/ルビー/パット

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「身長を米国式のフィートで言うと面白い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying how it'd be funny to talk about your height in feet the American way.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opener. Slight smile in the voice. Unhurried pacing — she's sharing something small and tender, watching him notice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとエアー、つまりエアフォースのスニーカー買ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I bought Air Force sneakers together.
lines.style: Quick, bright delivery. Small pride underneath — he's reporting something that mattered. Conversational, not performed. Natural child energy without being loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古いクロック、つまり時計を直して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad fixed an old clock for us. He's really good with things like that.
lines.style: Gentle, almost marvel in her voice. Speaking slowly enough for the observation to land. Noticing what he does quietly. Warm admiration, not overdone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとエリザベス女王のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched a documentary about Queen Elizabeth.
lines.style: Calm, direct report. Small hint of wonder that he got to sit with his dad for something like that. No performance — just remembering and telling her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ミスター・ビーンの映画を一緒に観よう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying we should watch a Mr. Bean film together sometime.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. She's passing along something Dad said — casual but genuine. Unhurried. A small moment of him planning time with Sho.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとSF作家ハワードの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at a picture book by Howard, the science fiction writer.
lines.style: Clear, straightforward boy-voice. Pride that it was something with Dad. Simple pleasure in the telling. No rush, no embellishment — just what happened.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがママの誕生日にルビーの指輪を準備されたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad is preparing a ruby ring for your mom's birthday.
lines.style: Thoughtful delivery. She's noticing what he's planning in secret — a glimpse of his care. Quiet warmth. Slight wonder that he's thinking ahead like this.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとゴルフのパット練習に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went to practice putting at the golf range.
lines.style: Warm close. Final memory — small and ordinary but held carefully. Quiet satisfaction. He's telling her something that felt complete, something shared.
